title: Grey Cat The Flag 2024 Qualifiers
description:
Grey Cat The Flag is a CTF hosted by NUS Greyhats in collaboration with National Cybersecurity R&D Labs.

We will host the onsite finals in Singapore, to the top 20 local teams from the qualifiers will be invited.

A team can be considered a local team only if all its members participating in this CTF event are Singapore Citizens, Permanent Residents (PR), or Long-term Pass holders.
